title: Critical minerals
hook: The energy transition runs on minerals from very few places.
notes: Mine production shares ≈ 2023, US Geological Survey Mineral Commodity Summaries 2024, rounded. Refining shares ≈ IEA Global Critical Minerals Outlook 2024. China export controls: gallium and germanium (2023), graphite (2023), selected rare earths (2025).

scenes.title: Cobalt
scenes.text: About three quarters of the world's cobalt is mined in the DR Congo. It goes into most lithium-ion batteries.

scenes.title: Lithium
scenes.text: Australia digs about half of the world's lithium; Chile and China follow.

scenes.title: Rare earths
scenes.text: China mines roughly 70% of rare earths, the metals inside wind turbine and electric-car magnets.

scenes.title: The real bottleneck: refining
scenes.text: Mining is spread out. Refining is not. China processes about 90% of rare earths, around 75% of cobalt and two thirds of lithium, and has started restricting exports of some of them.

legend.label: China: ≈ 90% rare earths, ≈ 75% cobalt, ≈ 65% lithium refining
